privacy.stored.flagsBody: in localStorage: whether you installed the app and when you dismissed the banner.
privacy.sentTitle: What is sent, and to whom
privacy.sent.countsBody: A successful identification also increments a counter for that track (title, artist, day). It is an aggregate — no account, no device id, no address, and no link between you and the track — and it exists only so trending can show what this app’s users actually identify.
privacy.sent.audioBody: Audio samples are produced only while you are identifying: a 16 kHz mono WAV is posted to this app’s server, forwarded to ACRCloud, and returned — it is not written to disk and is not retained after the request. Search terms go from the server to the provider; your API keys stay on the server and never reach the browser.
privacy.cookiesBody: No cookies, no third-party analytics, no advertising identifiers. The only persistent browser values are the two install flags described above, and they never leave your device.
privacy.copyrightBody: Only files a provider publishes for download are saved: catalogue preview clips and hosts an operator has explicitly put on the authorized list. YouTube videos are streamed through the official player and are never downloaded or extracted. Nothing here circumvents DRM, paywalls, access controls or platform terms. If a provider does not offer a file, the app says so instead of showing a button that cannot work.
privacy.controlsBody: Clear search history from Library → Searches. Erase everything, or export a JSON copy, from Settings. Removing a library entry never deletes a file that was already saved to your device.
privacy.thirdParty: Third-party terms apply to the content they serve: ACRCloud, Apple Music / iTunes, and YouTube. Respect the rights of the artists and rights holders whose work you are identifying.

videos.catalogNoticeBody: Apple publishes a preview clip and cover for each video, so this tab works with no YouTube credentials. Keyword search on YouTube itself still needs a key.
videos.youtubeKeyTitle: YouTube search needs an API key
videos.youtubeKeyStep1: Create a project in Google Cloud and enable YouTube Data API v3.
videos.youtubeKeyStep2: Create an API key (restrict it to this server’s IP or the YouTube Data API).
videos.youtubeKeyStep3: Add YOUTUBE_API_KEY=… to .env and restart the server.
videos.youtubeKeyMeanwhile: Meanwhile, paste a link below — playback and title resolution work without a key.
videos.pasteHint: Paste a YouTube link or 11-character id.
videos.streamBody: Watching streams the clip from the platform that hosts it. YouTube videos are never saved by this app. Catalogue previews are the only video files that can be downloaded, because the provider publishes them for that use.
downloads.noticeBody: Catalogue preview clips — audio (M4A) and music videos (M4V), both published by Apple for preview use — plus files from hosts on the server’s authorized list. YouTube videos cannot be downloaded here; the embedded player only streams them.
downloads.saveFromLinkHint: Paste an https link to a file you own, have permission to save, or that the provider publishes for download.
downloads.storage1: No storage permission is requested up front. Nothing broad is asked for.
downloads.storage2: Android / Chrome: files go through the browser download manager into the device’s Downloads folder. The page cannot pick that folder for you.
downloads.storage3: Desktop Chrome / Edge: a save dialog lets you choose the exact folder and filename.
downloads.storage4: Video: catalogue music-video previews (video-ssl.itunes.apple.com) can be saved as MP4/M4V. A YouTube link is refused by the server — that is the policy, not a bug.
downloads.storage5: iOS Safari: the file lands in Files → Downloads and can be moved from there.
downloads.storage6: Downloaded files are never stored inside the app database — only the record above.
identify.offlineTitle: The recognition API is not reachable.
identify.offlineBody: Start the server with npm run dev so the app and the API run together.
identify.unconfiguredTitle: Recognition is not configured on this server.
identify.unconfiguredBody: Add ACR_ACCESS_KEY, ACR_ACCESS_SECRET and ACR_HOST to .env (or the host’s environment settings), then restart.
identify.micPrivacyBody: Capture starts only after you tap the record button and stops the moment matching begins or you cancel. The WAV sample is uploaded to ACRCloud for identification and is not written to disk.
song.lengthVsClipBody: The duration above is the song’s real length. In-app audio from the catalogue is a short licensed clip, so “Hear full song” opens the whole track in its provider, and “Play full” streams the official YouTube upload — a two-hour mix included — without downloading it.
song.fullAudioNote: Full audio is never extracted from streaming services; playback always happens in the platform that hosts it.
